newsitem.title: FRANCE: Traders await confirmation of Tunisian wheat deal.
newsitem.headline: Traders await confirmation of Tunisian wheat deal.

text.p: European grain traders said on Friday Tunisia may have bought 125,000 tonnes of optional soft wheat but they were still waiting for official confirmation.
Prices cited ranged from $166.87 to $170 per tonne, including cost and freight.
On Wednesday Tunisia launched a tender to buy 125,000 tonnes of soft wheat for shipment in April, May and June.
The deadline for submitting offers was set for Friday March 14 at 0930 GMT.
A trader said on Friday that bids had already been reviewed and that official confirmation was expected later that day.
